name: CA Department of Rehabilitation (DOR)
blurb: The state agency that assists Californians with disabilities, including late-diagnosed autistic adults, in obtaining employment and maximizing independent living.

name: AANE (Assoc. for Autism and Neurodiversity)
blurb: A massive hub offering online support, education, and resources specifically built for Autistic adults navigating life after a late diagnosis.
facets: Free virtual support groups for adults

name: California DDS Autism Resource Hub
blurb: The state's official directory connecting autistic individuals to local Regional Centers, mental health services, and community support networks.
facets: Links to Regional Center adult services
